description: This file defines the 'Attributable' interface in the OpenMRS project, providing method signatures for objects that can be assigned or serialized, with deprecated methods for retrieving possible values.

classes.name: Attributable
classes.description: Interface for classes that can be associated with a PersonAttribute, providing serialization, deserialization, and display methods.

methods.name: hydrate
methods.description: Deserialize a string into a full object representation.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Convert the current object into a string identifier.

methods.name: getPossibleValues
methods.description: Retrieve all possible values for the object, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: findPossibleValues
methods.description: Search for possible values based on a search string, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: getDisplayString
methods.description: Get a user-friendly string for display purposes.
